verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's annual-report page says it files annual reports automatically in all states as they come due, using direct integration with secretary of state portals. It also gives clients visibility into due dates, filing status and approved documents, which makes this a provider-managed filing service rather than DIY reminders. Missing for 10: details of what the service prepares versus what the client must supply, pricing or add-on packaging terms, and independent or hands-on confirmation that filings are completed as claimed.
